summary: Rows and columns of data: the browser's own table, in the kit's geometry.

root.note: Full width, rows as tall as ui-geometry's row, a hairline under each row, header cells in the muted ink.

guidance.text: A native table with data-ui="table", with thead, tbody, th and td as in plain HTML, and a caption or aria-label as its name.

notYet: A header that stays in view while the body scrolls.
